why: Neither delivers the mustard velvet sofa or ceramic pots, but B's large blue-and-rust rug, teal cushions, navy throw and cognac sofa give the colorful, lived-in boho warmth the client asked for, and the rug is scaled to this big room. A's black sofa, grey kilim and grey plaid throw read muted and somber, with only one colorful cushion design to lift the scheme.
